CREATE TABLE pc_source_runners (
	runner VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	subject VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	capabilities BLOB NOT NULL, 
	capabilities_digest VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	last_seen_at DATETIME, 
	PRIMARY KEY (runner)
)

CREATE TABLE pc_source_collect_targets (
	scope_id VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	target_id VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	runner VARCHAR(128) NOT NULL, 
	capability VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	target_key VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, 
	parameters BLOB NOT NULL, 
	enabled BOOLEAN NOT NULL, 
	updated_at DATETIME NOT NULL, 
	updated_by VARCHAR(256) NOT NULL, 
	last_attempt_at DATETIME, 
	last_success_at DATETIME, 
	consecutive_failures BIGINT DEFAULT '0' NOT NULL, 
	last_error_code VARCHAR(128), 
	last_error_message VARCHAR(1024), 
	PRIMARY KEY (scope_id, target_id), 
	CONSTRAINT uq_pc_source_collect_target_key UNIQUE (scope_id, runner, capability, target_key)
)
